issues.title: Loan Simple leads receiving duplicate tasks in pre-referral and post-referral workflows
issues.desc: Loan Simple leads were enrolling in multiple workflow branches simultaneously, causing HAs and TCs to receive duplicate tasks. The issue was traced to a bugged filter related to Loan Simple lead associations in HubSpot. HubSpot support was engaged and confirmed the fix.
issues.workaround: Review any LS leads that received duplicate tasks during the impact window and manually close or reassign any duplicate tasks that were incorrectly generated.

issues.title: Post-referral workflow tasks not stopping when deal marked as Closed Lost or Transferred
issues.desc: HAs continued to receive weekly check-in tasks from the post-referral workflow even after deals were marked as Closed Lost or Transferred. The workflow filters were not correctly suppressing enrollment for these deal stages. A tweak to the workflow filters was applied to resolve this.
issues.workaround: Manually cancel any open post-referral tasks for deals that were marked Closed Lost or Transferred during the impact window.

issues.title: Offer Accepted workflow not re-enrolling deals that previously fell through and went back under contract
issues.desc: When a deal was marked Offer Accepted, reverted to a prior stage after a contract termination, and then marked Offer Accepted again, the TC workflow did not re-trigger tasks. This was because re-enrollment on the 'deal stage = Offer Accepted' criterion had not been enabled. The workflow was updated to allow re-enrollment.
issues.workaround: Manually enroll any deals that went through a second Offer Accepted transition during the impact window to ensure TCs receive the correct tasks.

issues.title: Post-referral workflow tasks not triggering for referral accepted on March 18th
issues.desc: An HA reported receiving no tasks after a referral was accepted on March 18th. Investigation revealed a data-pulling error that prevented the workflow from filtering correctly, blocking task creation. The issue was escalated to the product team for resolution.
issues.workaround: Manually enroll affected leads in the post-referral workflow to generate the missing tasks for leads accepted during the impact window.

issues.title: MRC and other TC Sale Pending and Offer Accepted workflows not enrolling leads
issues.desc: TC workflows for Sale Pending and Offer Accepted stages were not enrolling MRC and other applicable leads, resulting in TCs not receiving tasks or emails. The impact window ran from February 26th through April 1st. The issue was confirmed resolved and announced on May 4th.
issues.workaround: Manually enroll any MRC or affected leads that transitioned to Sale Pending or Offer Accepted between February 26th and April 1st to ensure TCs receive the correct tasks.

issues.title: Buyer credit SMS sent to clients before closing information submitted, missing credit amount
issues.desc: An SMS notifying buyers of their credit amount was being sent at the Offer Accepted stage before closing information had been submitted, resulting in a message with a blank or missing credit amount. The SMS should only trigger at the Sale Pending stage once the credit amount is calculable. The issue was confirmed to be a dash-triggered communication and was escalated to the product team.
issues.workaround: Manually send the buyer credit SMS with the correct credit amount to any clients who received the incomplete SMS during the impact window.
